about_the_game:
I/O is a minimalist but deeply strategic puzzle-arcade game where every bounce matters — and one wrong move could end your run.

At its core, I/O is about survival. You bounce between two platforms filled with numbered cells. Each bounce reduces a cell’s value — and if you ever land on a cell showing zero, it’s game over. Unless… you’ve got a power to save you.

🧠 Plan Your Moves. Adapt Fast.
Each run presents a fresh grid and unique challenge. Think ahead, redistribute cell values, and use your limited powers wisely. Every 5 stages, you’ll enter Split Mode — a tactical break where you can transfer half the value of one cell into another, giving you a chance to balance the board and extend your life.

🧬 Choose Your Powers
Before each run, pick two powers to bring with you. These are game-changers:

  • Safe Bounce: Survive a 0 hit once.

  • Value Boost: Double the value of a cell.

  • Overcharge: Double your score for one bounce.

  • Zero Cleanse: Turn a 0 into something usable.

  • And more...

Each power has limited uses, so timing is everything.

📈 Progress & Unlock
Earn score by surviving longer and bouncing smart. Use that score to unlock new power-ups in the Power Store, giving you more tools and strategies for future runs.

🧩 Key Features

  • Endless, score-based gameplay focused on strategy and adaptation

  • Power-up system with 8+ unique abilities

  • Split Mode for mid-run cell value redistribution

  • Clean, responsive visual design

  • Strategic layer that rewards planning and risk management

  • Steam support and progression tracking

  • Highly replayable with new combinations and runs each time

How long can you stay in the loop?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7 (SP1+) / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A mouse is required. Keyboard optional.
